scope: All 48 final structured/shuffled V2 formal decisions. Single unblinded assistant review; intermediate formal rounds and no_active not semantically rated.

rubric.relation_aligned: Relation consistent with the text actually supplied under the cited ID; not mechanism truth.
rubric.partial_or_mixed: Some agreement but a defining condition is omitted or extra mechanisms are mixed in.
rubric.insufficient_or_conflicting: Relation absent from, or conflicting with, the cited supplied text.

evidence_limit: Final proposed checks have no subsequent experiment; matched-state counterfactual tests were not separately executed. Valid IDs and predictive fit do not validate physical mechanisms.
